question:
i followed the document https://docs.getdbt.com/guides/best-practices/writing-custom-generic-tests and was trying to write the generic test "is_even" from here but when i am running the below generic test called is_even using dbt test command,it is giving me the error - "Database Error in test is_even_my_first_dbt_model_id (models/example/schema.yml) Syntax error: Unexpected "%" at [25:23]"

test_is_even.sql -

{% test is_even(model, column_name) %}

with validation as (

    select
        {{ column_name }} as even_field

    from {{ model }}

),

validation_errors as (

    select
        even_field

    from validation
    -- if this is true, then even_field is actually odd!
    where (even_field % 2) = 1

)

select *
from validation_errors

{% endtest %}
title: dbt: Syntax error: Unexpected "%" in generic test
answer: The datawarehouse for me was bigquery and to find the remainder, we use MOD function not %
